# routeros_mpls_ldp_interface (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_mpls_ldp_interface" "interface" {
  interface                = "ether1"
  accept_dynamic_neighbors = true
  comment                  = "Managed by OpenTofu"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `interface` (String) Name of the interface or of the interface list LDP is run on.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `accept_dynamic_neighbors` (Boolean) Whether to accept LDP neighbors discovered by the basic (link) hello messages received on this interface.
- `afi` (Set of String) Address families for which LDP is enabled on this interface.
- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `hello_interval` (String) Interval between the LDP hello messages sent on this interface.
- `hold_time` (String) Time the neighbor discovered on this interface is kept without receiving a hello message from it.
- `transport_addresses` (List of String) List of the IPv4/IPv6 addresses advertised as the LDP transport addresses in the hello messages sent on this interface. Overrides the instance-wide setting. The order is significant.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/mpls/ldp/interface get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_mpls_ldp_interface.interface "*1"
```
